title: Enter a branch's office hours
summary: The days and hours the branch is open. You can choose several days at once; one time range is created per day.

inputs.days_of_week: List of days, 0=Sunday, 1=Monday … 6=Saturday (e.g. [1,2,3,4,5] Monday to Friday)

steps.title: Choose the branch at the top
steps.details: Each branch has its own hours. If you have several, repeat this guide for each one.
steps.description: Hours are per branch: above the list there's a tab for each branch. Make sure you're on the right one.

steps.title: Opening days
steps.details: Check all the days with the same hours: one time range is created per day. Unchecked days stay closed and no appointments are offered.
steps.description: Check all the days with the same hours. If you open differently on Saturdays, enter them in another schedule.

steps.title: Opening time
steps.details: Before this time no appointments can be given at the branch, even if the doctor is available.

steps.title: Closing time
steps.details: After this time no appointments are offered. To break at midday, enter two time ranges on the same day.
steps.description: If you close at midday, enter two time ranges: morning and afternoon.

steps.title: Save the schedule
steps.details: Saves the time ranges. The calendar and the patient portal use them right away.
